mapper.insert: insert into xl_destination_wish (user_id, destination_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{destinationId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from xl_destination_wish where user_id = #{userId} and destination_id = #{destinationId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from xl_destination_wish where destination_id = #{destinationId}
select id, user_id, destination_id, create_time from xl_destination_wish where user_id = #{userId} and destination_id = #{destinationId} limit 1
